name: estatex
description: EstateX — real estate discovery platform (monorepo: Next.js web + NestJS api + Prisma/Postgres)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @estatex/api && npm run build -w @estatex/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @estatex/web && npm run lint -w @estatex/api
scripts.format: npm run format -w @estatex/web && npm run format -w @estatex/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @estatex/api && npm run test -w @estatex/web
